nodes.name: Victorian Era Constellation
nodes.description: A gateway cluster for civic institutions built during Melbourne's late nineteenth-century expansion.

node children.name: Flinders Street Station
node children.description: An iconic transport landmark recognized for its domed architecture and long-standing role as the city's meeting point.

node children.name: Royal Exhibition Building
node children.description: One of Australia's earliest World Heritage listed buildings, symbolizing exhibition culture and industrial-era ambition.

node children.name: State Library Victoria
node children.description: A cultural anchor of public learning, known for preserving archives and inviting generations into shared knowledge spaces.

nodes.name: Gold Rush Constellation
nodes.description: A constellation mapped to places that echo migration, wealth, and social upheaval from the gold rush era.

node children.name: Old Melbourne Gaol
node children.description: A former prison site tied to colonial justice stories, remembered for notorious inmates and public memory.

node children.name: Old Treasury Building
node children.description: Built to administer gold revenues, this building reflects the economic machinery that shaped nineteenth-century Melbourne.

nodes.name: Queen Victoria Market
nodes.description: A living marketplace where food, trade, and everyday social rituals keep layers of city history visible.
